_comment_1: DETECTOR dataset profile. Drives generate_realistic.py, NOT generate_grid_transforms.py.
_comment_2: The 25k det training set was built with the GRID generator (7x6 cells, <=6 words/cell, 8% empty) = ~121 words/image at ~32% text area. Real Marathi/Hindi scene photos carry ~11 words/image. That 11x density gap taught the detector to expect text everywhere and to read periodic stroke texture as text, which is why it over-fires on awnings, grilles and trusses with high confidence.
_comment_3: min_groups 3 / max_groups 8 with ~1.9 words per group lands at ~10-11 words/image. Verify with: python FineTune/det_dataset_stats.py --dataset-dir <out> --real-csv <fullpage_real_marathi/after_per_image.csv>
_comment_4: bg_dir MUST point at real street/building photos containing the clutter the detector currently false-positives on (shutters, corrugated awnings, lattice trusses, window grilles, railings). With negative_frac 0.20, one image in five is that clutter with no text on it at all.
